cases.query: Who is the current Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu?
cases.answer: The current Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu is C. Joseph Vijay [1, 2, 3, 4]. He shifted to a new official residence at Chennai's Greenways Road on November 6, 2026 [1]. Vijay, a former Tamil film star, was sworn in as Chief Minister on May 10, 2026 [4, 6].
